# Radoslav Radev Requires Increasing Body Temperature By One Degree As A Warm-Up Before Planche And Front Lever Training

Radoslav Radev requires increasing body temperature by one degree as a warm-up before planche and front lever training, and says that joint rotations alone are not a warm-up. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 02:30]

## Details

- The warm-up is increasing the body temperature by one degree. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 02:30]
- Jumping jacks, running, or jump rope are much better than just rotating the lower back, elbows, and head. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 02:36]
- One degree increasing the body temperature is definitely enough; if you get a little bit of sweat, that means it is really good and you are ready to start. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 02:54]
- After the warm-up, you can do your stretching: shoulders for the planche, biceps, wrists, and elbows. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 03:08]
- He says the warm-up that increases your body temperature is the most important part. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 03:14]

## Evidence

- vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 02:19 (Radoslav Radev): "The third thing is you don't warm up properly. And this is really common because I see how the people started the training for the planche front lever and they just doing something like this or something like this, and this is not a warmup."
- vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 02:30 (Radoslav Radev): "The warmup is increasing the body temperature with one degree so if you do jumping jacks or if you do back flips or running or jump rope is much better than just rotating the lower back elbows like this the head like this and that's not a warm-up"
- vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 02:43 (Radoslav Radev): "this is why i see how a lot of people get injured because the joints are cold and this is a mistake"
- vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 02:54 (Radoslav Radev): "you have to understand that one degree increasing the body temperature is definitely enough if you get a little bit sweat that means it's really good and you're ready to start"
- vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 03:08 (Radoslav Radev): "after that, yes, you can do your stretching, the shoulders for the planche, the biceps as well, to rotate the wrists, the elbows as well."
- vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 03:14 (Radoslav Radev): "the warm-up that increasing your body temperature is the most important."

## Why This Matters

He says he sees a lot of people get injured because their joints are cold, and joint rotations alone do not warm up the body. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 02:43]
